body:
cargo-llvm-cov [already supports signature verification using github artifact attestations](https://github.com/taiki-e/cargo-llvm-cov#from-prebuilt-binaries).

As far as I know, there are [already quite a few crates using github artifact attestations, and that number is on the rise, and very few crates use binstall’s own signature style](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Ataiki-e%2Finstall-action+%2F%22%28gh-attestation%7Cminisign-binstall%29%22%2F&type=code). Therefore, rather than requesting that individual repositories add support for binstall’s own signature style, I recommend adding support for github artifact attestations verification to binstall itself.

Considering that both mise and install-action already support github artifact attestations verification, this should be feasible task.
